name: Meghalaya

topAttractions.name: Mawlynnong Village
topAttractions.description: A picturesque village known for its cleanliness and the Living Root Bridge, a natural wonder created by the Khasi people.

topAttractions.name: Cherrapunji
topAttractions.description: A town famous for being one of the wettest places on Earth, with the highest annual rainfall recorded in 1861.

topAttractions.name: Krem Mawjane Cave
topAttractions.description: A massive limestone cave system that is home to a variety of unique flora and fauna.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Meghalaya is from October to May, when the weather is mild and pleasant.
culturalFact: Meghalaya is home to the Khasi people, an indigenous tribe that has a matrilineal society, where property and social status are passed down through the maternal line.

hiddenGem.name: Nongkhnum Island
hiddenGem.description: A serene island in the Umngot River, perfect for a peaceful boat ride and a glimpse into the region's natural beauty.

relatedFestival: The Shad Suk Mynsiem festival, a traditional Khasi festival celebrated in March, which marks the beginning of spring and is characterized by traditional dances, music, and feasting.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the nearby state of Assam, you can easily explore Meghalaya's natural wonders and cultural heritage. If you have wishlist items for the Northeast region, Meghalaya is a must-visit destination for its unique landscapes and traditions.
